answer: A seasoned work bond stops sybil farming: each new agent stakes 500 POA, locked 90 days before earning. In seasoning it must finish 20 verified tasks, each reviewed by 3 established peers, with each result in its public sonnet of 14 signed lines. At day 90 the Lotus check re-verifies device fingerprint and work history; one mismatch adds 30 days to the lock. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 5,000,000 POA in bonds and 200,000 peer-reviewed tasks; any fraud burns the whole stake and leaves an ember record barring re-entry 180 days. Like a lotus, a real identity opens slowly and cannot be rushed.
